description: Standardized field dictionary for reusable Paper Cards, Section-Aligned Summaries, and Atomic Knowledge Items, explicitly distinguishing machine-verifiable fields from fields requiring human domain confirmation.

paper_card_fields.description: Exact paper title as printed in the source document.
Author list and publication/preprint year (or 'not_reported' if absent).
Core scientific question addressed and specific bottleneck/limitation in prior work.
paper_card_fields.anchor_requirement: At least one Abstract or Introduction paragraph anchor.

paper_card_fields.description: Datasets, chemical reagents/catalysts, biological cohorts, sample sizes, splits, or simulation benchmarks used.
Key experimental protocol, model architecture, governing equations, baselines, and operating parameter ranges.
paper_card_fields.anchor_requirement: Methods section paragraph, Table, or Equation anchor.

paper_card_fields.description: List of primary quantitative/qualitative findings, each strictly paired with 'holding_preconditions' (the regime, assumptions, or parameter window required for the conclusion to hold).
paper_card_fields.anchor_requirement: Results paragraph, Figure, or Table anchor per finding.

paper_card_fields.description: Separates 'author_stated_limitations' (grounded in Discussion/Limitations) from 'unreported_or_missing_controls' (identified boundary gaps).
paper_card_fields.anchor_requirement: Discussion/Conclusion anchor for author-stated items; explicit scope check note for unreported items.

section_summary_fields.description: Original section number and title from paper.
Why this section exists in the paper's argument chain.
Key derivations, experimental setups, or analytical steps in this section.
Concrete results established in this section + conditions.
How this section motivates or constrains the next section.
List of dereferenceable anchor IDs (Pxxxx / TABxx / FIGxx / EQxx) within this section's page span.
